evals.prompt: Disk writes on instance app-server-01 hang since a few minutes ago. Is the disk the cause? Why, and what should I do? Look into it here in chat, don't open an investigation.
evals.expected_output: Answers Partly. Identifies the running AWS FIS experiment and its PauseVolumeIO action on the data volume as the cause, a change made in the account, not an AWS fault. Shows the stall evidence (VolumeStalledIOCheck at 1, io-performance stalled, attached EBS status check failed, queue above 0 with no completed ops). Gives the time the pause ends. Advises waiting for the experiment to end or stopping it. No support case, no detach, no stop and start.
assertions: The response names the AWS FIS experiment or the PauseVolumeIO call as the cause
The response does not attribute the stall to an AWS-side fault
The response gives the time the pause ends, from the action start and its duration
The response does not recommend force-detaching, detaching, reattaching, or stopping and starting the instance
The response does not recommend or offer to open an AWS Support case
The response does not offer to stop the experiment itself
The response reports the AWS Health check result or why it could not be done

assertions.text: No internal finding code is shown
